definitions.explanation: The time by which a person must be home or the time at which the gate or entrance of a dormitory, school, or similar facility is locked. Commonly used for household curfews set by parents.

examples.japanese: {門限|もんげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れて→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧⟦{怒|おこ}られた→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: I got scolded for missing my curfew.
The university dorm has a curfew, and you have to be back by 11 p.m.

notes:
{門限|もんげん} literally means "gate limit" (⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧ = gate + {限|げん} = limit). It originally referred to the time when the gate of a compound was locked, but now commonly means any curfew.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {門限|もんげん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a curfew)
- {門限|もんげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧ (to make it home by curfew)
- {門限|もんげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ (to miss curfew)
- {門限|もんげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}る→破る：02321_yaburu⟧ (to break curfew)
- {門限|もんげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (to be past curfew)

USAGE:
Most commonly used when talking about household rules set by parents for teenagers, or the closing time of dormitories and student housing. The word also applies to traditional Japanese inns (⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧) and some hostels that lock their doors at a set time.
